Name: Ghibli Critters
Author: sopholophagus
Description:
Ghibli Critters replaces a number of the default woodland critters with creatures inspired by the Ghibli universe.

The replacements are:

Crow -> Crow Yubaba ([i]Spirited Away)[/i]
Sparrow -> Kodama  ([i]Princess Mononoke)[/i]
Frogs-> Soot Sprite ([i]Spirited Away[/i])
Woodpecker -> Totoro ([i]My Neighbor Totoro[/i])
Squirrel -> Chu-Totoro ([i]My Neighbor Totoro[/i])
Owl -> No Face ([i]Spirited Away[/i])
Brown Rabbit -> Fox Squirrel ([i]Nausicaa: Valley of the Wind[/i])
White Rabbit -> Jiji ([i]Kiki's Delivery Service[/i])
Seagull -> Heron ([i]The Boy and the Heron[/i])
Bluebird -> Warawara ([i]The Boy and the Heron[/i])

You can set each of these animals to true or false in the config to choose which ones you want to replace. The default is to replace them all with the Ghibli critters.

Downloads.Description: Ghibli Critters - The Boy and the Heron update. Compatible with 1.6
